$Comment: Names the hytale:operator reading for requirement lines: 1 when the player is one of the server's operators (the group /op puts them in), else 0. It reads the game's own operator status, never a permission node, so granting a node (even *) never makes a player an operator here. A condition on it needs Min 1. It is asked fresh every time (Volatility Moment), so an operator removed with /op remove loses it at once.
